reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and has already given this month, A answers my real worries: it guarantees all-or-nothing refunds, shows $11,000 already pledged by businesses, promises public spending reports, gives a reopening date, and is upfront about the roof cost and film timing. B never says I'd get my money back, leaves the cinema's name blank, and its "half of what we asked last time" framing feels like spin.
